token_rule: split normalized answer and key by space; token counts must be equal

- suffix class differs -> no match (classes: ing, ed, s [s only if length > 3], none)
- edit distance (Damerau-Levenshtein OSA) > allowed(len(y)) -> no match
space_rule: if token counts differ by exactly 1 and both strings are equal
after removing all spaces -> match with 1 typo (e.g. barchart = bar chart)
